post.text:
9 year-old, 🇺🇦 Oleksandra Paskal has ALREADY been banned for life from the @Olympics, they state that her showing off her prosthetic leg is 'politics' and unfair to the neutral 🇷🇺 russian athletes and the @iocmedia that might have to look at her.

What do you think? https://t.co/IgRFJsuivA
post.author_description:
🇬🇧 British volunteer supporting Ukraine since 2022.
We Don't Make Drones.
Awarded for contributions to the AFU by General Valerii Zaluzhnyi 🎖
Based in Lviv.

description.description: A rhythmic gymnast with a prosthetic leg performs a routine on a gymnastics mat in front of an audience. Frame 1 shows the gymnast standing with arms outstretched. Frame 2 captures her performing a hand-balanced move with legs split. Frame 3 shows her performing a standing split while holding her prosthetic leg vertically. Frame 4 shows her from behind as she completes a turn with arms raised.

tweetMedia.transcription: Коли настане день, закінчиться війна, Там заубив себе, побачила ж до дна. Дякую за перегляд!
